identity_reason: it holds articles the product draws, usually Cards, so only the stream and its keys are its own
concept: A stream of articles that loads more near the end, with Page Down and Page Up between articles and an end said in words.

root.why: the feed and its end line stack at the section rhythm

feed.why: articles stack at the section rhythm with no pane of their own

article.why: each article takes focus with the ring around its card

end.why: the end line keeps a 44px height so the page does not jump as it changes

status.why: loading and the end are said in words in the secondary tone

more.why: Load more is an underlined button with a 44px press area for anyone who does not scroll

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard
